critiques.note: Set the hair and beard base to #362926 and shifted the highlight (#5e4134) and shadow (#221a1b) to match, so the shading still reads.

critiques.text: Make his shoulders wider, his hands look goofy
critiques.note: Widened the chest to 24px with bigger shoulder caps set further out (about 32px across) and redrew the hands as rounded, shaded fists the width of the wrist.

critiques.text: The side walk looks super strange, give him some bend in his arms and knees when he walks.
critiques.note: Redrew the side walk with bent knees (heel strike, toe push-off, and a passing leg lifted with the knee forward), elbows bent and swinging opposite the legs, and the far arm showing behind the body.
